title: ClusterLinkRequest
description: Batch Request to link clusters to the environment in a batch

clusters.description: List of cluster identifiers and names

linkAllClusters.description: Link all clusters to the environment. When true, links all clusters matching the searchTerm.

searchTerm.description: Search term to filter clusters when linkAllClusters is true. Only used with linkAllClusters=true.

skipClusterValidation.description: Skip cluster existence validation in GitOps service. When true, allows linking clusters without verifying they exist in GitOps. Useful for pre-provisioning scenarios or when clusters are being created asynchronously.

scope.description: scope at which the cluster exists in harness gitops, project vs org vs account

ClusterBasicDTO.description: List of cluster identifiers and names
